entries.note: Kobayashi AAC epub 2010-11-29, quote verbatim in abstract. Opening proxy acceptable; Min 2010 AAC (10.1128/AAC.00842-09, epub 2009-11-02) already reports 'potent in vitro anti-HIV activity', so 2009 was available.
Min 2011 AIDS (PMID 21716073) quote verbatim; viral load proximal tier correct. Registry NCT00708110 results first posted 2013-10-30, matches.

Min 2010 AAC (PMID 19884365, epub 2009-11-02); quote verbatim in abstract, which itself states PA-IC90 0.064 ug/mL. Untested opener at 2009, dolutegravir, oral, unselected correct. Judgement's 'abstract gives PA-EC50 only' is stale prose.
Min 2010 abstract quote verbatim: HV 50 mg Ctau 1.6 ug/mL ~25x PA-IC90. Target reached = same; HV PK counts; no earlier patient result for the drug, so not retro. Year 2009, oral, unselected correct.
Quote is the abstract's first sentence, verbatim. Exclusion of SHIV-macaque PrEP models from treatment context is reasonable. 2009 opening also available (Min 2010).

entries.rule: Retrodiction rule: for efficacy a model first public after a patient result on the same target and action (member or not) is a retrodiction; one that reproduced the human data is retro, never same
entries.note: SPRING-1 (PMID 22018760, epub 2011-10-20) quote verbatim; combination_with and note correct. But the DTG cell-culture model (2010) post-dates raltegravir's patient efficacy (Phase 2/3 2007-2008) on the same target and action: retrodiction true, retro.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule (efficacy is a target claim): the DTG cell-culture model (2010) post-dates raltegravir's patient efficacy on the same target and action (2007-2008); it reproduced SPRING-1, so retro, not same.

entries.note: Label 2013 (bundle) quote verbatim; rabbit 0.4x exposure confirmed; PharmR states no teratogenicity in rats/rabbits.
Zash 2018 NEJM letter (PMID 30037297, epub 2018-07-24); quote verbatim in PMC6550482. Contra, 2018, dolutegravir, oral, unselected correct. Judgement still carries a stale 'could not quote' sentence.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6 (year = earliest public date, congress abstract included, even when a later paper is the higher-tier source of the status)
entries.note: Brummel 2025 (PMID 40880283, epub 2025-08-26) quote verbatim; tier 1 attenuation supports same. But attenuation was public at AIDS 2022 poster PELBB02 (Zash): DTG 10/9,460 (0.11%) vs non-DTG 25/23,664 (0.11%) (i-base htb/43791). Year 2022.
entries.adjudication_note: Evidence rule 6: status stands on Brummel 2025 (tier 1, attenuation to background), but the attenuation was first public at AIDS 2022 (Zash, DTG 0.11% vs non-DTG 0.11%), so the entry dates to 2022.

entries.note: Kobayashi AAC (PMID 21115794) epub 2010-11-29; quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested at 2010 is right; patient level fits (panel predicts which genotypes respond). MedR confirms FDA weighed fold-change.

VIKING (PMID 23225901, epub 2012-12-07) quote verbatim; abstract confirms DTG with failing regimen (no RAL) to day 10, day-11 primary. biomarker_selected, oral, combination note correct. Not retro: no earlier patient result for DTG in RAL-resistant virus (see rule question).

entries.rule: Evidence rule 2 (source_tier 1 = peer-reviewed paper) and rule 6 (epub_year)
entries.note: Koteff BJCP (PMID 22905856, online 2012-08) quote verbatim; untested opener 2012, oral, unselected right. Fields still inconsistent: src is a peer-reviewed paper so source_tier 1 not 2, epub_year 2012 not 2013 (as on safety 5).
entries.adjudication_note: Opener status untested agreed; correction is fields only (rule 2: Koteff BJCP is tier 1; rule 6: epub_year 2012). Not the track's latest entry, so no untested_reason.

entries.note: Koteff abstract quote verbatim; iohexol/PAH unchanged, CLcr fall only, in healthy volunteers. Prospective test of the no-true-GFR-loss claim on the drug's own data, so same not retro; year 2012 (online 2012-08) correct.
Mohan EBioMedicine (PMID 33341441) epub 2020-12-18; quote verbatim. Opening untested at 2020 correct; NIH-funded, model_filed false right.
Quote verbatim. Model run after the 2018-2019 Tsepamo signal and matched it: retro, not same (decision 10). Five NTDs, all 1x-DTG, confirmed.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6 (year = earliest public date, congress abstract included)
entries.note: Brummel quote verbatim; contra/opposite and retrodiction false (2020-12 model precedes the update) hold. First public absence of the human signal is AIDS 2022 PELBB02 (DTG 0.11% vs non-DTG 0.11%), so year 2022. Judgement keeps stale 'Kept retrodiction true'.
entries.adjudication_note: Evidence rule 6: contra/opposite holds (2020 model precedes the attenuation, retrodiction false), dated to the first public absence of the signal, AIDS 2022 Zash (0.11% vs 0.11%), so year 2022.

entries.note: Tukeman AIDS PMID 37382903; quote verbatim in abstract. Crossref record created 2023-06-29 (ahead of print), issue 2024, so year 2023 holds. Opening untested entry for a distinct folate-sensitised CD-1 system is right.

Quote verbatim in abstract; exencephaly at therapeutic-equivalent DTG only on low-folate diet. Built after the 2018 Tsepamo signal and offered as its explanation, so retro with retrodiction true is correct.

Brummel AIDS PMID 40880283 (epub 2025-08-26); quote verbatim. Contra/opposite holds at low confidence: Brummel never names folate, so the low-folate condition the model needs is the drafter's inference from Botswana's lack of fortification.

missing: Min 2010 AAC 10.1128/AAC.00842-09 (epub 2009-11-02): 'C(tau) with a 50-mg dose was 1.6 microg/ml, approximately 25-fold higher than the protein-adjusted 90% inhibitory concentration (0.064 microg/ml)': healthy-volunteer dose comparison the draft omits; moves dose dating earlier.
Zash et al. AIDS 2025, 10.1097/QAD.0000000000004326: earliest peer-reviewed report of the Tsepamo NTD signal attenuating (0.10% vs 0.11%).
Zash 2018 NEJM letter 10.1056/NEJMc1807653 (epub 2018-07-24) and the May 2018 FDA/EMA safety communications: first public NTD signal, a year before the scored entry.

Zebrafish embryo DTG developmental-toxicity model (Cabrera et al. AIDS 2019, 10.1097/QAD.0000000000002289; Cabrera 2026 DMM 10.1242/dmm.052632): folate-receptor antagonism and NTD-type defects set against the Tsepamo signal; no track.

Second mouse NTD model, SWV/Fnn and other strains dosed with DTG (Tukeman et al. AIDS 2024, 10.1097/QAD.0000000000003639; Gelineau-van Waes 2023 Front Cell Dev Biol 10.3389/fcell.2023.1175917): DTG-induced NTDs, folate-responsive; a separate model system from the C57BL/6J therapeutic-dose track.

Hypomagnesemic-mouse DTG NTD model (Gelineau-van Waes et al. 2023, Front Cell Dev Biol 10.3389/fcell.2023.1175917): low-Mg diet / LM/Bc strain sensitiser, folded into the low-folate track as a note; a different sensitiser, so arguably its own model_id.

Tsepamo AIDS 2022 late-breaker poster PELBB02 (Zash et al., Montreal, Jul-Aug 2022; https://i-base.info/htb/43791): DTG-at-conception NTD 0.11% vs non-DTG 0.11%, the earliest public attenuation; dates safety 3 and 8 to 2022.
rule_questions: When the first public patient signal is a tier 1 letter with no abstract (Zash 2018) and a tier 2 regulator communication exists but could not be retrieved, should the contra be dated to the first public signal (2018) or the first quotable source (2019)?

For dose 'reached, drug worked', is the entry dated when both halves are public (HV PK reaching target 2009 + first efficacy 2011) via pairing, or does it need a source that states trough vs target and response together (FDA review 2013)?
Class-wide harms not tested against tox packages (INSTI weight gain, DTG creatinine/OCT2, neuropsychiatric AEs): does rodent silence on weight gain count as a miss the species could have shown?

mouse-low-folate-dtg-ntd safety 11: the model predicts NTDs only under low folate; the patient source (Brummel 2025) does not report maternal folate status. Is contra allowed when the model's sensitising condition is inferred for the population rather than shown by the patient source, or must it be untested?

Retrodiction for patient-level efficacy tracks: the INSTI resistant-mutant panel (2010) post-dates raltegravir patient results on the same target, but no patient result had yet shown which RAL-resistant genotypes respond to dolutegravir. Does the target-level retrodiction rule cover a patient-level (genotype) prediction? Efficacy 1 and engagement 1-2 on hiv-cell-culture-replication also post-date raltegravir and carry retrodiction false.
